title: Certify Z3's one-argument xor through both proof cores
summary: The Lean reconstructor and clause-log exporter now accept Z3's one-argument xor, rendering it as its argument and proving its two gate clauses, so inputs such as z3test 3434.smt2 are certified through both proof cores. No C++, Lean source, or CI change; zero and three-or-more argument xor nodes stay rejected.
